recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, dark cosmic collage featuring pixelated celestial bodies with thermal-gradient textures, overlaid with geometric glitch artifacts, scanline patterns, and 80s-era digital display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Spherical planets contrasted against sharp rectangular glitch frames
Vibrant neon thermal gradients against a deep black starfield
Horizontal scanline textures unifying disparate collage elements
Large display text anchored at the top with smaller subtitle centered below
coreInvariants: Visible horizontal scanline or raster pattern across all elements
Thermal-style color mapping (cyan, magenta, yellow, green) on planets
Deep black background with fine white stippled star noise

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large overlapping spheres dominate the lower right and center; geometric frames occupy the left mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest planet in the lower right quadrant acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top-aligned text, moves down through the central spheres, and follows the vertical glitch strips on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space provides high contrast for the neon and white elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon Cyan, Magenta, and Lime Green (Thermal Planet Textures)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation accents against a low-value, high-contrast background.

letterConstructionRules: Segmented or 'dotted' texture mimicking early digital dot-matrix or LED displays
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are composed of small horizontal segments or dots
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-tech digital display font paired with a contrasting organic, slanted script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary organic contrast for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark cosmic collage with a black starfield. Include two large spheres with neon thermal-map textures (cyan, magenta, yellow). Add rectangular glitch frames on the left and vertical rainbow-colored data strips on the right. Apply a consistent horizontal scanline filter over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, condensed dot-matrix style uppercase text at the top. Below it, center a smaller subtitle in an orange-red slanted marker-style script.

verificationChecks: Is the scanline texture visible across the planets?
Are the planets colored with a thermal-gradient look?
Is the background a deep black with fine star noise?

adjustableVariables: Thermal color palette (e.g., shifting toward blues or reds)
mustRedesign: Identifiable facial features if present in textures
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern vector smoothness; maintain pixelated edges.
Check that the scanlines do not obscure the text legibility.
Verify the thermal colors feel 'electronic' rather than natural.
Confirm the collage feels layered rather than a single flat image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Cosmic Background] + [Thermal Texture Spheres] + [Geometric Glitch Overlays] + [Scanline Filter] + [Dot-Matrix Typography].
